rating_summary: Combined star scores use a vote-weighted blend of Letterboxd and IMDb-scale data. IMDb-scale values prefer IMDb title-page data; OMDb or TMDb may fill gaps—TMDb averages are TMDb community scores, not necessarily live imdb.com. The compact vote figure adds IMDb and Letterboxd vote counts when both exist. Figures are a snapshot when this file was exported.
